disclosure: Models that reached OpenRouter or the Hugging Face API in the window. Each row says whether the weights are published, which is an attribute of the release rather than a grade: an API-only model is shipped and serving traffic, it is simply not downloadable. Dates are when the model reached the source, not the vendor's own announcement date, and the Hugging Face dates are repo creation, which can sit either side of a public release. The two sides are not counted the same way, so the open and API-only totals are not comparable: OpenRouter is taken in full, while Hugging Face is a fixed list of labs capped at five repositories each. No benchmark scores, by choice. A model announced but never shipped cannot appear in any release list, including this one.
